senses.gloss:
A boiler, pot, vessel. चरुं पञ्चबिलमुखं धर्मोऽभीन्धे [[Av. 11. 3. 18.]] 
-खा 
__1 A boiling vessel, a boiler or cooking pot (such as a sauce-pan; Mar. शेगडी). अन्यो ह्यग्निरुखाप्यन्या नित्यमेवमवेहि भोः [[Mb. 12. 315. 15.]] 
__2 A fireplace at a sacrifice. 
__3 A part of the body. 
-Comp. उखासंभरणम् N. of the sixth book of the Śatapaṭha Brāhmaṇa.
Salt extracted from saline earth (Mar. सांबरलोण).

उखर्वलः,
उखलः A kind of grass (भूरिपत्रः तृणभेदः)

__1 Salt prepared from saline earth. 
__2 Nitre or saltpetre.
